jobs.description:
At BlinkTroll, we’re building next-generation training systems and defense technology used by military and police forces across Europe. Our mission is simple but urgent: to support the defenders of the free world with powerful, practical, and life-saving technology.

We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineering Specialist to join our team in Odense, someone who can work independently, communicate clearly across disciplines, and take ownership of complex mechanical systems from idea to field deployment.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving real problems, exploring new ideas, and working closely with a small team of hardware, software, and embedded engineers.

What You’ll Do

• Design and prototype mechanical systems and components from concept to field-ready solutions

• Work closely with embedded, software, and electronics engineers to build fully integrated systems

• Develop 3D CAD models, assemblies, and technical documentation (SolidWorks, Fusion360 or similar)

• 2D technical drawings

• Take full ownership of mechanical design decisions and implementation

• Support assembly, testing, and troubleshooting in-house and during field testing

• Help scale systems from prototype to small-scale production

• Contribute ideas and improvements to system architecture and product design

• Communicate clearly with the team and help translate concepts into practical engineering solutions

Who You Are

• 8+ years of experience as a mechanical engineer or mechanical design engineer

• Comfortable working independently and driving projects forward

• Strong communication skills and able to collaborate across engineering disciplines

• Experienced in 3D CAD and designing for manufacturing

• Hands-on and comfortable working with tools, prototypes, and test setups

• Curious and open-minded, always looking for better solutions and new ideas

• Reliable, structured, and comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment

• Based in or near Odense, or willing to work on-site

What We Offer

• Work on technology with real-world impact

• A hands-on engineering environment in Odense’s robotics and defense ecosystem

• A small, ambitious team where your ideas matter

• Direct influence on product and technical direction

• Strong team culture

• Opportunity to grow with the company

If this sounds like the right next step in your journey, we’d love to hear from you.

Let us know why you’re interested and what you’d bring to the role, please send a motivation and your application to career@blinktroll.com

ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

As a global leader in facilities services we connect people and places to make the world work better. Whether directly or indirectly, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our placemakers in delivering exceptional workplace experiences for our customers. Together, we make space for people and businesses to thrive.

Location: Copenhagen, DK

Language: English

Main purpose of the position:

As Sales Operations Specialist, you will be driving the implementation and anchoring of the global initiatives in our core sales function and will transform our global commercial approach into world class, standardized, focused and proactive. You will also support countries deploying the tools, processes and platforms to drive an efficient sales execution strategy.

What you’ll do:

• Anchor ‘ISS Way of Selling’, a standardized global set of sales processes that provides an efficient commercial ecosystem and frames the sales execution process

• Drive adoption of the ISS Sales Process, enabling transparent, data-driven, and proactive interactions between our sales teams and our customers, enforcing a customer driven approach

• Support the Commercial Capabilities Development processes going across onboarding, competencies development and Commercial Academy

• Implement and drive the continuous improvement of the already launched tools, systems and processes required to build effective sales teams in countries and globally

• Drive continuous adoption, usage, and development of our CRM platform in close coordination with the sales & commercial managers to drive viability and insights derived from our CRM platform and to enable enhanced sales performance

• Constantly scanning the ISS global commercial team for best-in-class tools, recommend standardization and adoption through bringing the best of ISS to be shared across the global organization

Who you’ll work with:

• Global and countries commercial team (across all roles)

Key qualifications:

• Solid sales experience - has held positions within sales, account management and/or sales operations in a global B2B environment (3+ years)

• Proven track record of driving improvement projects and initiatives beyond scope of initial role

• Experience in working within matrix organizations, with high cross functional collaboration abilities

• Project management capabilities, able to orchestrate the timely delivery of outcomes – possibly for different projects simultaneously

• Be analytical and structured.

Personal skills you excel:

• Be an excellent communicator, able to engage stakeholders at different levels and with different cultures

• Ability to maintain professionalism always under stressful situations

Why ISS

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.

ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.

How You’ll Apply

Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.

We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

About Envira

Envira turns satellite and geospatial data into climate-risk intelligence for banks, insurers and public authorities. Envira Flood covers flood and storm-surge risk at building level; Envira Agro covers crop and climate risk across agricultural portfolios. We're based in Copenhagen and won the EU Big Data from Space Award 2025 plus the Danish Grunddataprisen 2026.

The role

Full-time, on-site in Copenhagen five days a week. You'll own the platforms our customers use, working closely with our data scientists and leadership, with real influence on how our products are built and run. This isn't a standard corporate job: we're looking for people who ship and want to grow fast. There will be pressure, and real ownership to match.

What you'll work on

• Building and extending our web platforms and APIs

• Connecting our geospatial data and risk models to customer-facing applications

• Running and improving our Azure infrastructure: deployment, monitoring and reliability

• Data security and access control, in line with what financial-sector customers expect

Our stack

Python and FastAPI · React and TypeScript · Postgres · Azure · Docker

About you

• Newly graduated or up to 3–4 years of experience, with a degree in computer science, engineering or similar

• You've built something, run it in production yourself, and kept it running

• Comfortable across backend, infrastructure and frontend

• You use AI tools daily, and review, question and discard what they produce when it's wrong

• You prefer small, simple solutions that work over impressive architecture

• You raise problems early and make decisions without waiting to be told

• You live in Denmark and can work from our Copenhagen office five days a week. We don't offer remote work or visa sponsorship

Our working language is English; Danish is a plus.

What we offer

• Salary based on experience, with potential for warrants

• Free lunch at the office

• Ownership of real products used by banks, insurers and public authorities

• The opportunity for tremendous growth

Our process

Short screening call → two-hour practical task on realistic data with your usual AI tools (no whiteboard puzzles) → interview where you walk us through your solution and meet the team.

How to apply

Please apply through our application form (about 10 minutes; we ask for your CV, grades, GitHub link and salary expectation). We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.

We enhance the developer experience for Databricks engineers across various areas, including programming languages, linters, static analysis, IDEs, remote development environments, automated release pipelines, and test automation frameworks. Our current focus is on optimizing the Rust development experience across the organization.

**What We Look For

**

• Ability to contribute effectively throughout all project phases, from initial design and development to implementation and ongoing operations, with guidance from senior team members.

• Self-driven and passionate with a strong focus on delivering impact through team collaboration.

• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation that drives alignment and decision-making.

**About Databricks

**Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. jobs.occupation: AI Red Team Specialist – Lead Researcher in Agentic Security
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

What You’ll Bring

Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

To Fit Right In Here At The Tech Collective

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

Department: Business Ethics Compliance Office

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

Do you want to help shape global ethics and compliance in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Would you like to use your legal and/or compliance expertise and pharmaceutical industry experience to help our organisation make the right decisions? Join Novo as a Senior Compliance Counsel in the Ethics & Compliance (E&C) Strategic Operations and Advice team.

Anchored within the Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO), this role offers the opportunity to provide practical advice, strengthen global compliance processes and help turn our ethics and compliance strategy into action

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring strong ethics and compliance, legal or adjacent experience from a complex multinational environment, combined with the judgement to turn regulatory requirements into practical advice. You are comfortable building relationships across functions and communicating complex topics clearly.

• A degree in Law, Business or similar

• A strong professional track record from an Ethics & Compliance or Legal function

• Experience identifying, assessing and mitigating ethics and compliance risks

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear and practical guidance

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Experience working in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology sectors or FMCG, either directly or through a relevant consultancy or law firm

**What You’ll Do

**As a Senior Compliance Counsel, you will act as an expert and trusted adviser on global Ethics & Compliance (E&C) matters. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Operations and Advice, you will work with colleagues across our global Legal, Ethics & Compliance organisation and the business to identify risks and develop practical, compliant solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide day-to-day guidance and training on ethics and compliance matters, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption policies and procedures, helping colleagues translate requirements into practical decisions.

• Identify and assess compliance risks and develop proportionate mitigation approaches that support effective implementation globally and at headquarters.

• Develop and implement global processes, tools and best-practice guidance across key ethics and compliance risk areas, making complex requirements easier to understand and apply.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of our global ethics and compliance strategy and programme, including leading or supporting strategic projects and following progress through to delivery.

• Build trusted relationships across the business, Legal and Group Internal Audit, while monitoring emerging ethics and compliance risks and contributing to relevant industry association working groups.

• Support the Business Ethics Committee by managing the secretariat, preparing meetings and materials, documenting decisions and coordinating follow-up on global compliance programme activities.

**Who You’ll Work With

**The Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO) develops and leads the implementation of Novo’s global ethics & compliance strategy and programme, which focuses on the prevention of fraud, bribery, and off-label promotion. BECO is also responsible for Novo’s global systems and processes related to tracking payments to healthcare professionals, as well as compliance with data protection and AI regulations and respect for human rights.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise to compliance questions with global reach while working closely with colleagues across functions and geographies.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use your legal and compliance expertise to strengthen global ethics and compliance at Novo Nordisk, apply for the Senior Compliance Counsel role based in Bagsværd, Denmark by 8 November 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences in your CV about why you are applying. To support an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

Do you want to turn innovative ideas into medical devices that make a difference? If you have a flair for mechanical design, enjoy taking ownership and solving complex challenges, we would love to hear from you.

Ambu is currently looking for an **Experienced R&D Engineer to join our Mechanical Engineering team.**In this role, you will join a passionate team of engineers, all with different backgrounds, collaborating to drive our continued product innovation. You can expect to use your strong design background to broaden your experience across the full development cycle, ensuring continued professional and technical development.

In this position, you will likely thrive the most if you naturally tend to take charge and support your colleagues. You may be a strong mechanical designer in your field, but you should also identify yourself with the values of Taking Charge and Team Up. If you have experience in driving technical development, that will certainly help you succeed in this role.

The role is based at **our Innovation Site in Ballerup, Denmark.

**

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will be in a key position in the development of Ambu’s future products. You can therefore expect to:

• Identify user needs, design inputs and specifications through participation in the project start-up phase where interaction with key opinion leaders, doctors and other experts worldwide is crucial to fulfil the ambitious innovation targets

• Be a key influencer in significant development projects within Ambu

• Develop new, and further improve existing, mechanical design solutions of components and assemblies as well as optimization of existing designs for Ambu's extensive product portfolio within endoscopy, anesthesiology, and patient monitoring

• Have the responsibility for the mechanical design and construction of functionalities, parts and assemblies including quality aspects for robust and safe medical products

• Translate technology concepts into fully working prototypes ready for feasibility testing and process evaluation including documentation

• Ensure that the component or product is manufacturable in high volume, fulfils function and stays within defined cost framework

• Ensure continually updated documentation in accordance with the regulations from FDA and ISO certification including FMEA's, risk assessments and tolerance analyses

• Trust cooperation with internal and external partners. You will work in international development teams from Germany, Denmark, and Malaysia as well as with external partners, users, physicians, and suppliers

**Suggested candidate profile

**Skills and experience can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have.

Ideally, you can assess manufacturability from a designer’s perspective and bring practical, hands-on insights rather than purely academic approaches. Experience with micromanufacturing or integrating design for small metal and plastic parts will be considered an advantage. We welcome candidates with expertise in microparts, and previous experience with hearing aids or similar precision devices would be a strong plus.

• Successfully completed a technical or scientific course of study, e.g., mechanical or medical engineering resulting in a broad technical understanding

• Good strong knowledge of working with a CAD system e.g. Inventor, Solidworks, Creo, Catia

• Have some experience in product development and/or design of safety-critical products

• Experience working with the development of Medical Devices is considered an advantage, however other highly regulated industries could also be relevant

• Relevant experience in the design of mechanical and plastic components for high volumes from the fields of injection molding, extrusion, and tool design

• Professional level of both written and spoken English

• Strong team and communication skills, initiative, and courage to take charge in development project groups

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Do you want to grow with Ambu?

The team is expanding and would love to hear from you!  If this role sparks your interest, go ahead and apply today.

Department: Cloud

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the Role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews — giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

**About you

**We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**

The ideal background**

• At least three years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

• Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency.

• Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision

We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_

At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority.

We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star App Store rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

**About The Role

**Path to Plus is the engine that converts users into paying members and keeps them there. As a Backend Engineer on this team, you'll be building and shipping features as part of a cross-functional product team with a direct commercial mission — not executing on a spec handed down to you, but helping shape what gets built and why.

This is a product engineering role. The team owns the problem, not just the delivery. That means getting involved before requirements are written, connecting your technical work to user and business outcomes, and iterating based on real feedback. You'll work closely with engineering leadership — not as a follower, but as a collaborator who contributes to the plan. If you've worked that way before — or you're actively looking to grow into it — this is the right environment.

What you'll do

• End-to-end features. Ship features as part of the team's product cycle, from problem shaping to production.

• Multi-broker architecture. Stock tax support is live. The next challenge is redesigning the current model to support multiple brokers — a real architectural problem you'll be part of solving.

• Observability. You'll help us own the health of critical business flows and catch issues before users do.

• Azure migration. We're migrating our systems in the coming months. Cloud architecture thinking will be an active part of the role.

• Tech debt on the roadmap. We believe tech debt belongs on the roadmap, not hidden under it. You'll help identify, prioritise, and plan for it alongside the team.

What we're looking for

You're a backend engineer who takes reliability and code quality seriously, and you can move fast without cutting corners. We care more about how you build and think than about which stack you've used. If most of this sounds like you, apply, even if you don't tick every box.

• Strong backend experience in production. You've built and run services that real users depend on, in Java, Kotlin, Go or a similar language. Our stack is Java and Spring Boot. If you haven't used it, we expect you to be keen to learn it quickly, and we'll help.

• Comfort with distributed systems. You've worked with message queues, relational databases, or both, and you understand the trade-offs.

• A product mindset. You care why something is built, not just how. You're happy to question a requirement, suggest a simpler path, and judge your work by its effect on users and the business.

• Good engineering habits. You can read an unfamiliar codebase, spot its strengths and weak spots, and improve it over time without needing a perfect plan first. You think about reliability and data, and you're realistic about making change in a production environment.

• Practical use of AI tools. Every engineer here uses Claude in daily work. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to make it part of how you work.

Bonus points

None of these are hard requirements.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit, RabbitMQ or MySQL specifically

• Kubernetes, Argo, GitHub Actions, Grafana or Loki

• Running services in Azure or another cloud, including tuning resources and cost

• Experience with fintech, payments, subscriptions or regulated data

Why join us

• Visible impact. You're joining a team with a full pipeline, and your work will show results quickly.

• A company serious about engineering quality. We're actively investing in elevating engineering practices across the organisation. You'll be part of that, not just a passenger.

• Solid company. Independent, profitable, growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

• Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

• Room to grow. The scope of the work and the team's ambitions mean there's real room to step up.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone.

The office is a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen and stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks. Lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street — proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible.

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: Engineering Manager.

Our hiring process

• Screening call with the hiring manager (30 min) — online

• Technical interview: build something together with a Backend Engineer and the Engineering Manager (60 min) — onsite

• Culture conversation with the Engineering Manager and CTO (60 min) — onsite

• Meet the CEO (30 min) — onsite

jobs.occupation: Biostatistician and Research Computing Specialist for The National Center of Excellence PREDICT
jobs.description:
The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

•    Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. PREDICT also has strong international collaborations across the world.

You can read more about PREDICT here: www.predictibd.dk

medical degree programme and conducts research within the clinical specialties.
